analytic_contract.continuum_zero_inference: A strict sign change of real-space g10 on a time interval implies at least one continuum zero by continuity of the finite Fourier reconstruction of certified continuous X10.
analytic_contract.generic_simple_zero_regularization: If g10 has a simple zero and g11 is nonzero there, 2*abs(g10)*g11 is continuous but generically not C1. Therefore global C9 cannot be assumed from smooth g10/g11.
analytic_contract.important_limit: This formula freezes the correct lower-regularity route but does not yet certify numerical M0,M1,L0,L1 envelopes.
analytic_contract.safe_lower_regularity_modulus: |F_Y(t)-F_Y(s)| <= 2*(M1*L0 + M0*L1)*|t-s|, where M0>=sup|g10|, M1>=sup|g11|, L0 is a Lipschitz constant for g10 and L1 for g11 on the stencil interval.
analytic_contract.zero_crossing_detection: Strict opposite endpoint signs only, plus exact floating zero nodes. No near-zero epsilon threshold.

outcomes.NO_DISCRETE_ZERO_WITNESS_CONTINUUM_SEPAR: No discrete witness is found. This does NOT prove g10 stays away from zero continuously. A rigorous nonzero enclosure would still be required before using global C9.
outcomes.ZEROSET_WITNESS_LOWER_REGULARITY_REQUIRE: At least one exact node zero or strict time sign change is found. Freeze the lower-regularity branch. Do not use the global C9 FD8 Taylor remainder for Y across such intervals.

purpose: Determine the mathematically valid regularity route for the action-completed H4 Y flux F_Y=2|g10|g11 before any integrated full H4 Ward residual is evaluated. Bind Stage-E g10 to the already-certified continuous X10 representation, search only for exact-node zeros and strict adjacent sign changes, and freeze the lower-regularity modulus formula required if the zero set is encountered.
